scope: Visible vertical rainwater downpipe riser only. Roof collector, eave gutter and underground drain connection are outside this contract until physically authored and observed in benchmark evidence.

manufacture.pipe: Rigid round exterior rainwater pipe represented as a continuous manufactured tube with separate socket sleeves rather than stacked Unity primitive cylinders.
manufacture.couplers: Four separate socket sleeves at storey-scale joints provide visible assembly logic and a slightly larger outer diameter than the pipe body.
manufacture.supports: Wall saddles use a pipe band, stand-off, wall plate and fastener heads. Load transfer is pipe -> saddle -> stand-off -> plate -> RC facade.
prohibited: visible Unity primitive mesh in formal benchmark framing
unsupported decorative elbows or roof/ground connections not represented by construction evidence

dimensionsThickness.note: Dimensions are explicit fallback modeling choices chosen to replace the previous repeated primitive-cylinder approximation; they are not a claim of an identified historical product model.

pipe.albedoLinearIntent: neutral warm gray; no illumination painted into albedo
pipe.microstructure: fine extrusion/chalking relief only; no directional light source encoded
pipe.uvAging: mild exterior chalking under ordinary midsummer UV exposure
pipe.fresnel: dielectric grazing response supplied by the PBR shader

support.microstructure: subtle metal surface breakup; highlights remain lighting/reflection driven

mounting.supportCadence: two modeled supports per storey-scale interval, with explicit band/stand-off/plate/fastener construction at LOD0
mounting.legacyPolicy: Existing objects named RainGutter remain only as disabled provenance. All legacy RainGutter Renderers and Colliders must be disabled before formal evidence.

interfacesGapsSeals.pipeSocket: socket sleeve visibly overlaps the continuous tube without coplanar surfaces
interfacesGapsSeals.pipeClamp: support band encloses the pipe diameter and connects through a stand-off toward the facade
interfacesGapsSeals.clampFacade: wall plate sits against the facade-side datum with explicit fastener heads at LOD0

orientationExposure.sun: coherent midsummer Japanese sun with sky fill, contact shadow and reflection behavior from scene lighting
orientationExposure.rain: exposed vertical surface; socket and clamp undersides are locally sheltered

allowed: fine retained dust in sheltered hardware recesses

failureInjection: replace authored pipe mesh with Unity Cylinder primitive
delete a support wall plate or stand-off
remove a socket or force socket/pipe coplanar overlap
remove an LOD level or disable CrossFade
claim Visual Fidelity points without sealed real render evidence
